Our Free Model — 在 dsh 里装上这个插件即可，无需登录、注册: Our Free Model — install this plugin in dsh and use frontier models including DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Kimi K3 with no login, registration, or API key. The desktop app adds the EAC co-payment channel; from 2.0 it connects thirteen account channels (CodeArts, CodeBuddy, WorkBuddy, LobsterAI, Qoder, TRAE, Cline, Loomy, Raccoon, MiniMax, ZCode, and Gemini) while keeping the original anonymous free channel (login, account pool, credit claiming, a local OpenAI gateway and LAN forwarding, a dashboard, and a runtime log), all presented across six frosted-glass pages.
DSH Web 界面右下角的 DeepSeek 余额小鲸鱼挂件:余额/今日已用/: A DeepSeek balance whale widget in the bottom-right of the DSH Web interface: balance, today's usage, and peak/off-peak pricing; a customisable bubble click sequence (text, balance, today, peak/off-peak, image, random lines with weighted parallel choice); per-row styling and fonts; hover quick-edit; sound effects and per-turn usage; custom characters, animations, and audio; snapping and flip customisation.
web_fetch 由谁抓取：providers 用填了 Key 的引擎（都没有: Who performs web_fetch: providers uses the engines with a key configured (falling back to dsh's own local fetching when none is set or all fail); dsh uses dsh's own local fetching directly (free, no third party, but it does not render JavaScript).

为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面复刻 Claude Code De: A theme plugin that recreates Claude Code Desktop for the DeepSeek Harness web interface: ivory and warm-black canvases, ember-orange accents, a Claude-style model picker, permission segments, and an account drawer.
在 DeepSeek Harness 内直连免密免费模型：清单跟随上游更新、地区: Connect directly to key-free free models inside DeepSeek Harness: the catalog follows upstream updates, regional availability is probed automatically, reasoning effort takes real effect, and it includes a token usage dashboard plus an OpenAI-compatible local forwarding port.
是否允许模型调用 web_fetch（URL 内容抓取）。web_fetch 工: Whether the model may call web_fetch (URL content fetching). The web_fetch tool is mounted by dsh itself; turning it off returns a clear error instead of removing it from the tool list. The change takes effect immediately, with no restart.
搜索策略：fallback 逐个尝试（最省额度）；race 同时调用前 N 个引: Search strategy: fallback tries each engine in turn (cheapest on quota); race calls the first N engines at once and takes the fastest; merge calls the first N engines at once and combines and deduplicates the results (best recall, at N times the quota).
定义 Provider 的调用顺序。排在前面的服务会优先执行，如果请求失败（或额: Define the order in which providers are called. Services earlier in the list run first; if a request fails or the quota runs out, it falls back to the next available service in that order.
所有带 Key 的抓取都失败时，用不带 Key 的 Jina Reader 兜底: When every keyed fetch fails, fall back to the keyless Jina Reader (rate limited). With no fetch engine configured it is the only fetch channel.
当前会话已被占用，可能是其他正在运行的 DSH 导致的（如其他 dsh web、: This session is already in use, possibly by another running DSH instance (such as another dsh web or the desktop app). Quit the other DSH instances and try again.
同一模型，thinking 开启：先推理再作答（推理流作为思考块回传）。适合数学: Same model with thinking on: reasons before answering, with the reasoning stream returned as a thinking block. Suits math, multi-step debugging, and planning; slower and heavier on quota.
相同的搜索或抓取在这么多分钟内直接返回缓存，不再消耗额度。0 为关闭。缓存只在内: Return cached results for identical searches or fetches within this many minutes, without spending quota. 0 disables it. The cache lives in memory only and clears on restart.
同一模型，thinking 关闭：直接作答、最快、最省免费额度。适合工具调用/改: Same model with thinking off: answers directly, fastest, and cheapest on free quota. Suits tool calls, rewriting, and retrieval tasks.
Tavily 搜索深度：advanced 结果更相关，但每次消耗 2 credi: Tavily search depth: advanced returns more relevant results but costs 2 credits per call.
保存自动化任务，到点后在原会话中执行，并为智能体提供管理任务的工具。: Save automated tasks, run them in the original session when due, and give agents a tool to manage them.
每条结果的摘要长度（字符）。越长上下文越多，也越费模型 token。: Summary length per result, in characters. Longer means more context and more model tokens.
结果地区（ISO 3166 两位代码）。auto 使用各引擎默认值。: Result region (a two-letter ISO 3166 code). auto uses each engine's default.
在本机使用 SenseVoice 转写录音，首次使用需安装依赖。: Transcribe recordings locally with SenseVoice; install its dependencies on first use.
提供自动审查权限模式，由模型在每次工具调用前判断是否授权。: Provide an automatic approval permission mode where the model decides whether to authorize each tool call.
每一步把当前时间、浏览器时区和距上一条消息的时长告诉模型。: Tell the model the current time, the browser time zone, and the time since the last message on every step.
Codex 风格侧栏、工作区会话树、全局搜索和轮次导航。: A Codex-style sidebar, workspace session tree, global search, and turn navigation.
优先的域名，每行一个：结果中来自这些域名的条目排到前面。: Preferred domains, one per line: results from these domains are ranked first.
侧栏的自动化任务页面，以及会话里的任务卡片和提醒标记。: The Automation tasks page in the sidebar, plus task cards and reminder markers in sessions.
为智能体提供成员协调、消息通信和共享任务管理工具。: Provides agents with member coordination, messaging, and shared task management tools.
统一加载并安全管理本机 Agent Skills。: Load and safely manage local Agent Skills.
race / merge 策略同时调用的引擎数。: How many engines the race / merge strategy calls at once.
